---
title: "Modeling Checklist"
toc: true
---

## 1. Actors

Who chooses? Possible actors include offenders, victims, police, courts, regulators, firms, peers, and communities.

## 2. Choices

What are the available actions? Keep the first version small: offend/not offend, report/not report, inspect/not inspect.

## 3. Information

Who knows what? Separate objective risk from perceived risk, and private information from common knowledge.

## 4. Payoffs

What are the benefits, costs, sanctions, social rewards, stigma, or emotional payoffs?

## 5. Timing

Is the interaction simultaneous, sequential, repeated, or networked?

## 6. Measurement

What observable variable corresponds to the theoretical object? Recorded crime is not the same as true crime.
